phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Build baseline strength, reduce pain, establish habits. Focus on cervical and elbow rehab with gentle mobility work. Walking only — no running yet.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Introduce run-walk intervals. Progress exercise difficulty. Continue weight loss trajectory. Begin building cardio base.

phases.name: Advance
phases.description: Increase running duration. Maintenance rehab with added strength. Push toward continuous running. Target weight approaching goal.

phases.name: 5K Ready
phases.description: Build to 30-minute continuous run. Performance-focused training. Maintenance exercises. Reach target weight of 77 kg.
